description: This file initializes and renders the main React application component into the DOM. It imports React, ReactDOM, styles, and the main App component, then mounts the application to an HTML element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the React root.
